description: The global uniqueness tuple permits each status only once for an entity/kind, while the same requirement allows immutable revisions for legitimate different-status transitions. A valid re-entry such as required_pending -> required_failed -> required_pending has a different status at each transition edge but its final append violates the uniqueness constraint; amount or metadata correction under the same status is likewise impossible. The spec must either require monotonic state machines with no status re-entry/correction or define an idempotency/revision key and corresponding winner rule.

evidence.snippet: Same-status retries are unique on (uid, organ, entity_key, outcome_kind, outcome_status). A legitimate state transition appends a different-status revision; UPDATE/DELETE are rejected.
